source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use Ireasoning MIB browser professional:
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Open Ireasoning MIB browser, load the MIB files.
4. Setup the settings of MIB browser to access BMC according to the WEB UI SNMPv3 settings.
5. Left-click on the $target and expand subtree.
6. Right-Click on the node and use "Get Next" or "Get Subtree" to get all the values of the $target.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Use NetSNMP to check.
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Put the mib files into the netsnmp search path.
http://www.net-snmp.org/docs/FAQ.html#Where_should_I_put_my_MIB_files_
4. Use NetSNMP "get type" of command(s) to retrieve the values of the $target from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: snmpwalk (net-snmp), BMC SNMP agent must be enabled + community configured
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP "monitor_adapters" monitoring reads specific BMC MIB data via the SNMP agent; from a 2nd management host run `snmpwalk -v2c -c ${SNMP_COMMUNITY:?operator must set SNMP community (v2c) or v3 creds} "$BMC_IP" .1.3.6.1.4.1.8072.2.3.2.1.2 | grep -i adapters (or walk the vendor MIB subtree once the SNMP community/v3 creds + MIB are configured). Enable + point SNMP agent first.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpwalk output for the adapter OID subtree so the user confirms the monitor_adapters SNMP data is correct.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: SNMP queries need a management host + enabled/configured SNMP agent on the BMC (community/v3 + firewall); enabling SNMP is a config change, and some BMC SNMP sets expose credentials - use read-only community.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED; correctly identifies BMC-versus-host ambiguity and network-change risk, but treats supplyable Project adapter scope as permanent ambiguity.

original_test_intent: Retrieve the Project-defined adapter inventory and operational state over SNMPv3, map each entry to the correct BMC management NIC, host NIC, mezzanine, HBA or other approved adapter class, and compare stable identity and status with the platform topology without changing connectivity.
original_method: An engineer enables an SNMPv3 account in WebUI and uses IReasoning MIB Browser Get Next/Get Subtree on undefined `$target`; Criteria switch to Net-SNMP and neither source defines which adapter class is in scope.
manual_activity: An engineer must choose the adapter class and ownership domain, approve stable topology/status mapping, protect the active management path and configure SNMPv3. The agent can then collect bounded read-only inventory/state and reconcile it with independent evidence.
required_inputs: in-scope BMC NIC, host NIC, mezzanine, HBA or other adapter class
vendor MIB module/version and exact inventory/status object OIDs
index-to-slot/PCIe BDF/port/MAC/WWN or other stable identity mapping
expected populated devices and admin/oper/link/speed/health values
active management interface/path identification and out-of-band recovery
least-privilege SNMPv3 profile/ACL and independent Redfish/host inventory
approved client equivalence and cleanup policy
safety_requirements: Keep execution read-only: never issue SNMP SET, link enable/disable, VLAN, MAC, route, bond, firmware, reset or adapter configuration changes.
Do not assume an interface is non-management; map the active agent/BMC management path before interpreting or proposing any follow-on action.
Do not conflate BMC management NICs, host OS interfaces, PCIe functions, mezzanines and storage HBAs.
Do not use v2c, the generic `.1.3.6.1.4.1.8072...` example or grep-only/empty output as adapter evidence.
Protect SNMPv3 secrets and redact unnecessary MAC/WWN data while preserving stable correlation tokens.
Stop on ambiguous ownership/mapping, unexpected link change, write-capable object or connectivity instability; do not retry or remediate automatically.
agent_execution_scope: After engineer setup, query exact approved vendor-MIB adapter objects through bounded SNMPv3 GET/GETNEXT/WALK and retain typed indexes and states.
Correlate entries with the approved slot/BDF/port/redacted MAC or WWN topology and independent BMC/host inventory, reporting missing, extra, duplicate or stale mappings.
Do not operate WebUI, alter network/adapter state, assume management-path safety, claim IReasoning coverage when only Net-SNMP ran or issue a DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the adapter class/ownership scope, stable identity map and expected state baseline.
Identify and protect the active management path, configure/restore SNMPv3, approve identifier handling and tool equivalence.
Investigate mismatches with approved read-only diagnostics and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The command uses the wrong security mode and an unrelated demonstration OID; grep cannot establish adapter ownership, stable identity, link/admin semantics or topology correctness.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use exact vendor-MIB SNMPv3 objects for one approved adapter class, preserve typed indexed responses and correlate them with stable topology identifiers without any interface or route change.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IReasoning, SNMPv3 WebUI/account setup, undefined `$target`, Net-SNMP Criteria and 10/5-minute values remain preserved source evidence.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROJECT ADAPTER SCOPE AND TOPOLOGY CONTRACT REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Select and name the adapter ownership/class, map each MIB index to a stable physical/logical identity, collect bounded inventory and state over SNMPv3, and correlate it with Redfish and host/PCIe evidence while preserving the management path.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The identified chassis, BMC, adapter population/firmware, PCIe topology and matching vendor MIB.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC/MIB/client, adapter firmware/driver and platform topology revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor adapter inventory/status MIB, platform topology and Project network/storage-adapter specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds adapter ownership/class, stable identity, management-path protection, state semantics and privacy handling without replacing the original client checkpoint.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: BMC NIC evidence cannot prove host NIC/HBA state, host enumeration cannot prove BMC MIB correctness and Net-SNMP cannot claim IReasoning GUI coverage unless explicitly approved.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Class/ownership, objects, stable identity map, expected states, management path, reference and client decision.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC inventory may lag host link state or omit attributes; MAC/WWN exposure and unstable OS names require careful correlation.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may select one adapter class and approve Net-SNMP instead of IReasoning, but must record original/actual tool, class/ownership, omitted adapters and fields, object-level equivalence and unverified GUI coverage. Results cannot be generalized to omitted classes.
expected_evidence: approved adapter class/ownership scope and stable topology map
redacted SNMPv3 WebUI/account/ACL configuration and cleanup artifacts
vendor MIB identity with exact OID/type/index/status mapping
complete bounded typed SNMPv3 inventory/state with redacted stable correlation tokens
timestamped comparison with independent Redfish/host/PCIe inventory and active management-path record
proof no adapter/network state changed, tool-equivalence statement, connectivity/health logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: `adapters` does not identify an ownership domain or class, Procedure requires IReasoning/SNMPv3 while Criteria changes to Net-SNMP, `$target` is undefined, and DeepSeek changes to v2c plus an unrelated generic subtree. The read-only monitoring purpose remains recoverable through Project scope inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Adapter class, object mapping, expected topology and approved client are Project execution-readiness inputs for a clear read-only inventory/status purpose. Once supplied and manually configured, bounded collection is automatable, so permanent BLOCKED is not justified.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains hybrid execution but rejects v2c, the generic filter and unspecified ownership; adds stable topology identity and management-path safety.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION under ED-36 while retaining a hard gate until class/mapping/baseline exist.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently confirms its classification and strengthens cross-class non-equivalence, privacy and management-connectivity evidence.

review_improvement: Separates adapter ownership domains and makes stable topology identity plus management-path preservation mandatory, preventing a generic inventory result from being generalized across NICs, HBAs or BMC interfaces.
independent_technical_reasoning: Adapter is a broad but Project-selectable target class. The review must not guess which domain or map, yet those inputs can be supplied without changing the clear monitoring purpose. Manual setup and scope approval plus bounded read-only reconciliation therefore fits REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION rather than permanent BLOCKED.
